class.name: IfcSolarDevice
class.brief_description: A solar device converts solar radiation into other energy such as electric current or thermal energy. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcSolarDevice defines the occurrence of any solar device; common information about solar device types is handled by IfcSolarDeviceType .
